name: terra-form
description: Terra Form: real-world geography to game maps. TypeScript sources; tsc emits the JavaScript in place and it is committed, so the app runs with no build step.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p mcp/tsconfig.json
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit && tsc -p mcp/tsconfig.json --noEmit
